# Vendored bpkit

`vendor/bpkit` is Rift Lord's own frozen copy of bpkit, the Blueprint toolkit. Rift Lord
uses only this copy (`riftlord.core.bpkitlink`), in source runs and in the built app.
It changes only through `tools/vendor_bpkit.py --from PATH`; never edit it by hand.
